bundle.shortDescription: Animated Dynamic Island for macOS 13 Ventura and later
bundle.longDescription: Lightweight Rust + Tauri 2 Dynamic Island for macOS that hugs the notch: live media controls (Apple Music, Spotify, browsers), synced lyrics, Spotify Connect, notifications, volume HUD, drag-and-drop file shelf with Quick Look previews, clipboard history, download progress (Safari, Chrome, Steam), weather, AirPods battery and 12 languages.
